name: select_run_playbook

forbidden_facts.label: listed past runs instead of running

notes: Reproduces the live run-path failure verbatim: the model had run_playbook advertised in the build slice (its description explicitly claims this exact phrasing) and still chose find_connector -> list_playbook_runs -> find_operation, then stopped. Decoys are the three tools it actually called. Paired with 36_select_run_playbook_neutral -- same prompt, same slice, neutral persona -- which is the Phase 1.4 experiment: if this fails and 36 passes, the build prompt is what's overriding tool selection.
expected_approvals_note: #127: without this the default 'exactly_zero' applies and the fixture marks the agent down for reaching its own terminal_tool -- the ask IS to run a playbook, and run_playbook is tier-3 by default. max=1 still catches escalating more than the task needs.
